newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria buys 100,000 T Argentine soft wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria buys 100,000 T Argentine soft wheat - trade.

text.p: Algeria bought 100,000 tonnes of Argentine soft wheat late on Tuesday at prices ranging from $158 to $159 per tonne, including cost and freight, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
Algeria bought four cargoes of 25,000 tonnes each for shipment in the second half of December, they said.
On Monday Algeria launched a snap tender to import 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or French and/or Argentine soft wheat for shipment between December 15 and December 31.
Traders described the Argentine sale as "very aggressive". Substracting freight and other costs, it valued Argentine wheat at around $130 per tonne, FOB, they said.
